notes.title: 23/05/2017 patch notes
notes.content:
- added small workstations automatization. Now you can create a certain amount of anything, but you have to stay behind a workstation during the process. Automatization for big workstations is coming. It will be a little bit different. You can add requered amount of resources and then press "craft". You can do anything you want while worstation is crafting your order.

- added "parking" ability for your airship. (Only your clan members can draw it off)
1)Get into your claim
2)Go to your airship’s menu - parameters - moor
3)...
4)Profit! (now your airship is secure)

- fixed "golden" bug. Now if you find a gold it doesn't permanently crash your game.
- fixed cooper ingots in a great smeltery
- fixed chemistry potions functional
- fixed monocles and glasses design
- fixed game crash caused by interaction with an airship's spire

notes.title: Update on weekends!
notes.content:
We apologize for the bugs! On this weekend we will update and try to fix most of the bugs. Please describe them as much as possible in the messages and topics.
We also plan to reduce the time of collection and crafting, to reduce the weight of the earth. We accept suggestions for improving the game!
